```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Setup
# ==============================
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Core libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readxl)
  library(janitor)
  library(lubridate)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

# Cohort sizes
TOTAL_N    <- 310
SCREENED_N <- 108

# Helper functions
as_date_safe <- function(x) {
  v <- as.character(x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  out <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(v))
  # Excel serials (roughly 1955–2064)
  is_serial <- !is.na(num) & num > 20000 & num < 60000
  out[is_serial] <- as.Date(num[is_serial], origin = "1899-12-30")
  # Strings
  left <- !is_serial
  if (any(left)) {
    parsed <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(v[left], orders = c("Y-m-d","m/d/Y","d/m/Y","m/d/y","d/m/y","Ymd"), tz = "UTC"))
    out[left] <- as.Date(parsed)
  }
  # Clamp to reasonable range
  bad <- is.na(out) | year(out) < 2000 | year(out) > 2100
  out[bad] <- as.Date(NA)
  out
}

# Build long ctDNA table
build_ctdna_long <- function(dat, id_col) {
  val <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp", values_to = "ctdna_value_raw") %>%
    mutate(ctdna_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", gsub(",", "", as.character(ctdna_value_raw))))) )
  dt  <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp_date", values_to = "ctdna_date_raw")
  out <- val %>%
    mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp, "\\d+"))) %>%
    left_join(dt %>% mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp_date, "\\d+"))) %>% select(all_of(id_col), tp_idx, ctdna_date_raw),
              by = c(id_col, "tp_idx")) %>%
    mutate(ctdna_date = as_date_safe(ctdna_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_date)) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), ctdna_date, ctdna_value)
  out
}
```

```{r load_data, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Load and clean data
# ==============================
file_path <- "Natera_Sheet_cleaned.xlsx"
dat <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = 1, col_names = TRUE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(patient_id = record_id_linking_key) %>%
  filter(!is.na(patient_id)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(. == "", NA, .)))

# Build long ctDNA table
ctdna_long <- build_ctdna_long(dat, "patient_id")
```

```{r conversion_analysis, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# ctDNA Conversion Analysis
# ==============================

# Define non-metastatic at first ctDNA
non_metastatic_at_first <- dat %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(tolower(clinical_disease_state_at_time_of_first_ct_dna_nmibc_mibc_advanced_metastatic), "nmibc|mibc") &
    !str_detect(tolower(clinical_disease_state_at_time_of_first_ct_dna_nmibc_mibc_advanced_metastatic), "advanced|metastatic")
  )

cat("Patients without metastatic disease at first ctDNA:", nrow(non_metastatic_at_first), "\n")

# Get ctDNA conversion data for these patients
conversion_data <- ctdna_long %>%
  inner_join(non_metastatic_at_first %>% select(patient_id), by = "patient_id") %>%
  arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  mutate(
    first_ctdna_result = case_when(
      ctdna_value > 0 ~ "Positive",
      ctdna_value == 0 ~ "Negative", 
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    first_positive_date = ifelse(ctdna_value > 0, ctdna_date, NA),
    first_positive_date = min(first_positive_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_positive_date = ifelse(is.infinite(first_positive_date), NA, first_positive_date)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(
    first_ctdna_result = first(first_ctdna_result),
    first_positive_date = first(first_positive_date),
    ever_positive = any(ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    conversion = case_when(
      first_ctdna_result == "Negative" & ever_positive ~ "Converted",
      first_ctdna_result == "Positive" ~ "Always Positive",
      first_ctdna_result == "Negative" & !ever_positive ~ "Remained Negative",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Add clinical information
conversion_summary <- conversion_data %>%
  left_join(dat %>% select(
    patient_id,
    metastatic_disease_ever_diagnosed_yes_no,
    alive_yes_no,
    death_date,
    cause_of_death
  ), by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(
    metastatic_ever = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(metastatic_disease_ever_diagnosed_yes_no), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
      str_detect(tolower(metastatic_disease_ever_diagnosed_yes_no), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    alive_status = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(alive_yes_no), "yes|y|1") ~ "Alive",
      str_detect(tolower(alive_yes_no), "no|n|0") ~ "Deceased",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    death_date_parsed = as_date_safe(death_date),
    cancer_related_death = case_when(
      alive_status == "Alive" ~ "N/A",
      str_detect(tolower(cause_of_death), "cancer|bladder|tumor|metastatic") ~ "Yes",
      str_detect(tolower(cause_of_death), "other|cardiac|heart|stroke") ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

# Filter to converted patients only
converted_patients <- conversion_summary %>%
  filter(conversion == "Converted") %>%
  mutate(
    expected_count = round(n() / SCREENED_N * TOTAL_N),
    first_positive_date_formatted = ifelse(is.na(first_positive_date), "Not available", as.character(first_positive_date))
  ) %>%
  select(
    patient_id,
    first_positive_date_formatted,
    metastatic_ever,
    alive_status,
    cancer_related_death
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id)
```

```{r conversion_summary}
# ==============================
# ctDNA Conversion Summary
# ==============================

cat("## ctDNA Conversion Analysis\n\n")

# Overall conversion statistics
conversion_stats <- conversion_summary %>%
  count(conversion) %>%
  mutate(
    expected_count = round(n / sum(n) * TOTAL_N),
    percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)
  )

cat("**Overall ctDNA Conversion Status:**\n")
kable(conversion_stats, 
      col.names = c("Conversion Status", "N (Screened)", "Expected (Total)", "Percentage"),
      caption = sprintf("ctDNA conversion status among non-metastatic patients at first ctDNA (N=%d screened, %d total)", SCREENED_N, TOTAL_N)) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

cat("\n**Conversion Rate:**\n")
converted_count <- conversion_stats %>% filter(conversion == "Converted") %>% pull(n)
total_analyzed <- sum(conversion_stats$n)
conversion_rate <- round(converted_count / total_analyzed * 100, 1)
expected_converted <- round(converted_count / SCREENED_N * TOTAL_N)

cat("- Patients with ctDNA conversion:", converted_count, "\n")
cat("- Expected when chart review complete:", expected_converted, "\n")
cat("- Conversion rate:", conversion_rate, "%\n\n")
```

```{r converted_patients_list}
# ==============================
# List of Converted Patients
# ==============================

cat("## Patients with ctDNA Conversion (0 → >0)\n\n")

if (nrow(converted_patients) > 0) {
  cat("**Patient Details:**\n")
  cat("(Patients who had undetectable ctDNA initially, then became detectable)\n\n")
  
  # Format the table nicely
  converted_table <- converted_patients %>%
    rename(
      "Patient ID" = patient_id,
      "First Positive ctDNA Date" = first_positive_date_formatted,
      "Metastatic Disease Ever" = metastatic_ever,
      "Alive Status" = alive_status,
      "Cancer-Related Death" = cancer_related_death
    )
  
  kable(converted_table, 
        caption = sprintf("Patients with ctDNA conversion (N=%d screened, ≈%d expected when complete)", 
                        nrow(converted_patients), 
                        round(nrow(converted_patients) / SCREENED_N * TOTAL_N))) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
  
  cat("\n**Summary of Converted Patients:**\n")
  
  # Metastatic disease summary
  metastatic_summary <- converted_patients %>%
    count(metastatic_ever) %>%
    mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))
  
  cat("- **Metastatic Disease Development:**\n")
  for (i in 1:nrow(metastatic_summary)) {
    cat("  -", metastatic_summary$metastatic_ever[i], ":", metastatic_summary$n[i], "patients (", metastatic_summary$percentage[i], "%)\n")
  }
  
  # Survival summary
  survival_summary <- converted_patients %>%
    count(alive_status) %>%
    mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))
  
  cat("\n- **Survival Status:**\n")
  for (i in 1:nrow(survival_summary)) {
    cat("  -", survival_summary$alive_status[i], ":", survival_summary$n[i], "patients (", survival_summary$percentage[i], "%)\n")
  }
  
  # Cancer-related death summary
  death_summary <- converted_patients %>%
    filter(alive_status == "Deceased") %>%
    count(cancer_related_death) %>%
    mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))
  
  if (nrow(death_summary) > 0) {
    cat("\n- **Cause of Death (among deceased):**\n")
    for (i in 1:nrow(death_summary)) {
      cat("  -", death_summary$cancer_related_death[i], ":", death_summary$n[i], "patients (", death_summary$percentage[i], "%)\n")
    }
  }
  
} else {
  cat("**No patients found with ctDNA conversion from 0 to >0**\n")
  cat("(All patients either remained negative or were always positive)\n")
}
```

```{r detailed_analysis}
# ==============================
# Detailed Analysis
# ==============================

cat("## Detailed Analysis\n\n")

# Time to conversion analysis
if (nrow(converted_patients) > 0) {
  cat("**Time to ctDNA Conversion:**\n")
  
  # Get detailed timeline for converted patients
  timeline_data <- ctdna_long %>%
    inner_join(converted_patients %>% select(patient_id), by = "patient_id") %>%
    arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    mutate(
      first_negative_date = min(ctdna_date[ctdna_value == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
      first_positive_date = min(ctdna_date[ctdna_value > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
      days_to_conversion = as.numeric(first_positive_date - first_negative_date)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(days_to_conversion)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  if (nrow(timeline_data) > 0) {
    time_summary <- timeline_data %>%
      summarise(
        median_days = median(days_to_conversion, na.rm = TRUE),
        q1_days = quantile(days_to_conversion, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q3_days = quantile(days_to_conversion, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        min_days = min(days_to_conversion, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_days = max(days_to_conversion, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    
    cat("- Median time to conversion:", round(time_summary$median_days), "days\n")
    cat("- Range:", round(time_summary$min_days), "-", round(time_summary$max_days), "days\n")
    cat("- IQR:", round(time_summary$q1_days), "-", round(time_summary$q3_days), "days\n\n")
  }
}

# Risk factors analysis
cat("**Clinical Characteristics of Converted Patients:**\n")

if (nrow(converted_patients) > 0) {
  # Add clinical characteristics
  clinical_data <- converted_patients %>%
    left_join(dat %>% select(
      patient_id,
      race,
      ethnicity,
      cancer_stage_natera,
      pathology_t_stage,
      pathology_n_stage,
      neoadjuvant_systemic_therapy_yes_no
    ), by = "patient_id")
  
  # Stage distribution
  stage_dist <- clinical_data %>%
    count(cancer_stage_natera) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
  
  cat("- **Cancer Stage Distribution:**\n")
  for (i in 1:nrow(stage_dist)) {
    cat("  -", stage_dist$cancer_stage_natera[i], ":", stage_dist$n[i], "patients\n")
  }
  
  # NAC distribution
  nac_dist <- clinical_data %>%
    count(neoadjuvant_systemic_therapy_yes_no) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
  
  cat("\n- **Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy:**\n")
  for (i in 1:nrow(nac_dist)) {
    cat("  -", nac_dist$neoadjuvant_systemic_therapy_yes_no[i], ":", nac_dist$n[i], "patients\n")
  }
}
```

```{r export_data}
# ==============================
# Export Converted Patients Data
# ==============================

cat("## Data Export\n\n")

if (nrow(converted_patients) > 0) {
  # Create detailed export table
  export_data <- converted_patients %>%
    left_join(dat %>% select(
      patient_id,
      race,
      ethnicity,
      cancer_stage_natera,
      pathology_t_stage,
      pathology_n_stage,
      neoadjuvant_systemic_therapy_yes_no,
      date_of_first_diagnosis_of_bladder_cancer_any_location
    ), by = "patient_id") %>%
    mutate(
      diagnosis_date = as_date_safe(date_of_first_diagnosis_of_bladder_cancer_any_location),
      diagnosis_date_formatted = ifelse(is.na(diagnosis_date), "Not available", as.character(diagnosis_date))
    ) %>%
    select(
      patient_id,
      diagnosis_date_formatted,
      first_positive_date_formatted,
      race,
      ethnicity,
      cancer_stage_natera,
      pathology_t_stage,
      pathology_n_stage,
      neoadjuvant_systemic_therapy_yes_no,
      metastatic_ever,
      alive_status,
      cancer_related_death
    ) %>%
    rename(
      "Patient ID" = patient_id,
      "Diagnosis Date" = diagnosis_date_formatted,
      "First Positive ctDNA Date" = first_positive_date_formatted,
      "Race" = race,
      "Ethnicity" = ethnicity,
      "Cancer Stage" = cancer_stage_natera,
      "T Stage" = pathology_t_stage,
      "N Stage" = pathology_n_stage,
      "Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy" = neoadjuvant_systemic_therapy_yes_no,
      "Metastatic Disease Ever" = metastatic_ever,
      "Alive Status" = alive_status,
      "Cancer-Related Death" = cancer_related_death
    )
  
  cat("**Complete Patient Data for Export:**\n")
  kable(export_data, caption = "Complete clinical data for patients with ctDNA conversion") %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), font_size = 12)
  
  # Save to CSV
  write.csv(export_data, "ctDNA_conversion_patients.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n✅ **Data exported to:** `ctDNA_conversion_patients.csv`\n")
  
} else {
  cat("No patients with ctDNA conversion found to export.\n")
}

cat("\n**Analysis completed:**", Sys.time(), "\n")
```
